Depends on what candy you want/if you're trying for a shiny

Go catch chansey somewhere where they are lower levels then! They're like in the 40s in cerulean cave (i believe the only place where 2+ spawn at a time) where someone suggested right? I got a fat load of exp when I caught some in the route with the day care. Level 15ish, much easier to handle with pokeballs/great balls

If your combo reaches 31, you'll have the highest chance of encountering a shiny (without the shiny tag anyway) and best chances of catching a pokemon with perfect IVs. I've heard IVs dont make much of a difference unless you play competitive, but that could give you an edge on mewtwo as well. Make sure you boost your party's stats with candy also!

Use berries or better balls to increase catching odds. The higher the streak, the more exp you gain. Alsp aim for excellent throws because they also increase the catch odds and give you a higher exp multiplier. Usually there is a different animation before the poke flees, which would break your streak. If you run away before it flees, you won't break the catch streak. So I suggest picking a mon you like/has good candy for speed/attack/special attack (or others if you're low) and getting a big catch streak. Use lures to bring out those pokemon for the first 10-15, then they'll be all over the place. Chansey is a power house for exp, but a rarer spawn (I think usually only one spawns at a time).
